column1: # Paths the macOS head builds at run time, and what each can become. qt-paths.py asks the core
# about every instance; a template leaves the Qt debt only when all of its instances are claimed.
# Kept here rather than as comments in the Swift, so declaring a path never touches the head.
# Each line: template<TAB>use<TAB>instance, instance, ...   (use: write or action)
# An instance must fit its template, and a template that no longer appears in macos/Sources is
# refused -- a declaration left behind by a changed call would otherwise keep excusing it.
# MapClickModel.invokable, less guidedModeOrbit: shown() never offers orbit (it would send an
# invented radius and altitude), so that case cannot reach this call.
